title: Woven Waves
author: Cary Ravitz
problems: Row 5 "facing star counter-clockwise 3 places with robins putting their right hands in and backing up" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
The progression after row 8 "pass through up and down" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
